model_annotation: This bar chart compares the performance of six different language models—mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across multiple evaluation tasks, as indicated by the grouped bars along the horizontal axis. Each group contains six colored bars corresponding to the models listed in the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, light pink for mBERT-B₂, and red for XLM-B₂. The vertical axis represents performance scores, though the exact scale and units are not labeled; error bars extend above and below each bar, indicating variability or confidence intervals. Performance varies across tasks, with some models (e.g., XLM-B₂ and mBERT-B₂ in certain groups) achieving notably higher scores, while others (e.g., mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ in later groups) show consistently lower performance. The bars within each group are clustered together for direct comparison, and the overall layout suggests a side-by-side evaluation of model variants across different benchmarks or datasets. No axis titles or numerical scale labels are visible, limiting precise quantification but preserving relative comparisons.
